notes.title: Important update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Graphics resolution extended to 3k and 4k: the video game is now compatible for 3k and 4k screens as well as low resolution. Automatic detection when launching the game or manual selection manual in the options.

[*]Optimization of the game in quality and performance. Selection of 3 possible levels in graphic options.

[*] Implementation of the world ranking players in the video game (Top 10).

[*] Improved race rewards and end of race victory raffle by approximately 25%.

[*] Many corrections in menus and races. Some minor bugs fixed.

[/list]

notes.title: About the released in early access
notes.notes:
Dear community,

Glory Horse Racing will soon be available on Steam for early access. We are currently working on the different languages ​​available. We also plan to integrate a free Asia pack that will allow you to race on 2 new racetracks, as well as a multiplayer ranking based on the times and Xpoints of the game.
Steam achievements will be integrated after this development phase.

Finally, do not hesitate to send us your comments and suggestions which could also modify our development schedule.

Development team
